porosity_mapping.evidence: Decision D5 (user, 17 Nov 2026): G(phi) = 25300 * (1 - phi), the linear (Voigt) rule. It is an upper bound for any pore shape (Pabst & Gregorova, Ceramics-Silikaty 48 (2004) 14-23) and the rule the data's three G levels follow exactly (25300, 24541, 23313.95 MPa at phi = 0, 3, 7.85 %). Real pores, and the dilute spherical-pore estimate (Mackenzie 1950, slope -1.88), lower G faster. phi = 1 - density/2700 (D2). See docs/proposals/open-items-2026-11-17.md.
